intent: Preserve compiler-owned material issue bindings through Sol evidence envelopes; reject genuine-but-unrelated causal evidence; preserve locally declared causal refs through evidence freeze without globally requiring generic Sol context.
acceptance: Material issue relations are provider-derived and preserved in canonical evidence envelopes.
Established root-cause claims fail closed when actual, counterevidence, and discriminator do not share a material issue binding.
Genuine but unrelated evidence is rejected without a second relevance scorer.
Locally predeclared causal refs are promoted before evidence freeze so compression cannot silently drop them.
Generic Sol reasoning context remains priority-based and does not become globally required.
Focused and existing regression tests pass on the recovery branch before merge.
One-shot diagnostic and all temporary controls are deleted before final head.
